object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Defect: no test verifies it. Over stdio with --read-only, call each of the 29 refused tools. Expected: each result carries error_type PermissionError. A probe on 2026-11-11 gave isError true and the text 'Error executing tool set_attribute: Server is running in --read-only mode; write tools are disabled.', with no error_type and no 'PermissionError' anywhere. test_read_only_refuses_every_write_tool checks only the class of the exception raised in process, so it passes while agents never see the value.
